findings.charging_model: Jobs consume Service Units (SUs) as credits allocated to queues/partitions; charging factors per partition apply (see partition 'Charging Factor' table). Large-memory (highmem) nodes are charged 4 SU per compute core.
findings.note: Users exchange SUs for queue access; partition table includes per-partition charging factors; highmem explicitly charged 4 SU/core.
